question: The famous musician Aban Mistry is associated with which instrument?
solution: The correct answer is __**Tabla**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Aban E. Mistry was an eminent tabla player and scholar in** Hindustani classical music**. • She was the first woman tabla player and is listed in the **Limca Book of Records**.
